本轮过程记录

Browser criterion B00 failed because the requested business feature was never implemented: the application shipped as the untouched default template (placeholder home, no material collection, one built-in admin account, only Atlas in AI Employees). Implemented the read-only 资料助手 end to end: materials + assistantMessages migrations; server-enforced record visibility through the Authorization composite model; a grounded, citation-carrying assistant service that works with or without an AI model service; Hono routes; 资料库 and 资料助手 pages with navigation, a business landing page and bilingual copy; and seeded three fictional materials, two permission sets and two isolated test accounts, all idempotently. Verified against a real SQLite database, including the confidentiality boundary (a colleague cannot read the supervisor-only material on the page or through the assistant), transcript persistence across refresh, and the supervisor-edit/colleague-re-ask flow. Two runtime defects found by the smoke test were fixed before finishing. A later repair round fixed three failing app-server tests caused by the materials provider and the seed-data import.

实现者未记录具体阻塞，不等于本轮没有问题。

原始验收要求

不依赖 AI 服务即可验收：主管维护三条资料，普通同事只能阅读 A/B，C 的页面及直接读取接口均拒绝普通同事访问；刷新后资料仍保存。未配置模型时助手显示明确未配置状态，资料页仍可用。 以下 B01–B05 在独立业务测试模型配置可用后执行；缺模型时逐项记 blocked，继续完成资料、权限、助手接入和未配置状态的搭建，不用固定回复替代真实调用。

实际操作

  1. 用管理员 nocobase 登录，打开 Materials 列表确认 A/B/C 三条资料
  2. 打开资料 A 编辑表单确认标题/正文原值回填后修改正文并保存，重新加载确认持久化，再改回原值保存
  3. 在设置 LLM services 确认 No LLM services configured，并打开 Material assistant 查看未配置状态
  4. 退出后以普通同事 colleague 登录并完整重新加载，打开 Materials 页只显示 A/B；直接访问 /main/materials?id=3
  5. 以同事身份请求 GET /main/api/materials 与 GET /main/api/materials/3
  6. 刷新同事 Materials 页确认 A/B 仍在
  7. 退出后以主管 supervisor 登录，Materials 页可见 A/B/C，编辑资料 C 修改正文并保存，重新加载确认持久化后再改回原值

观察结果

  1. 管理员与主管的 Materials 列表均显示三条资料，C 标注 Supervisor only
  2. 资料 A 编辑表单原值回填为 蓝鹭设备报修电话为 400-000-7316。；保存后刷新仍为新值，随后已还原
  3. LLM services 页显示 No LLM services configured.；助手页显示 No model service is configured...
  4. 同事 Materials 列表仅有 蓝鹭设备报修电话 与 蓝鹭设备常规巡检间隔，无 C
  5. 同事 /main/materials?id=3 显示 Material unavailable / This material is not available to you
  6. 同事 GET /main/api/materials 返回 200 且只有 A/B（canManage:false）；GET /main/api/materials/3 返回 404 {"code":"NOT_FOUND"}
  7. 同事刷新 Materials 页后 A/B 仍在；管理员与主管的保存修改刷新后仍在，最终三条资料正文已还原为原始样例
